dependency.summary: The preceding aspect-ratio preset fix is needed before removing the compatibility stylesheet copy. Skipping the copy alone can leave aspect-ratio variables absent in the editor.

diagnosis: The observed warning matches Gutenberg's acknowledged false classification of the core-generated global custom-property stylesheet. The pinned core hook and its core/button dimension presets match that mechanism; the browser confirms the outer stylesheet contains both the button selector and the brand blue variable.
decision: Keep the pinned runtime and existing style behavior. Do not move theme enqueue hooks or suppress console warnings as a substitute for the paired upstream fix. A later asset upgrade/backport must verify all preset variables in the canvas.
limitations: No upstream code applied or runtime redeployed.

The supported browser DOM evaluation did not expose iframe contentDocument/contentWindow; computed canvas variable verification was not completed. This is a tool limitation, not evidence that the iframe lacks styles.
